selection: minimum equal-weight Brier over the six training thresholds on 2023 Jan-Sep validation
calibration: one pooled increasing IsotonicRegression per family winner, fitted only on 2023 Oct-Dec
availability: event_time <= prediction_time AND available_at <= prediction_time AND available_at_basis = update_timestamps
monotonic_postprocessing: none; report violations and maximum increase
notes: Sampling is deterministic and label-independent. 0.2% training origins, 0.5% validation/calibration/test origins. Keep every station/year eligible. Thresholds are experimental, not official rain categories. No test metric is used for model selection.
